settings.provider: Model provider. Configure API keys securely in the Beacon sidebar; keys are not stored in Settings.
settings.deepseek.baseURL: API base URL (without /chat/completions). Use the endpoint for your account region.
settings.bailian.baseURL: API base URL (without /chat/completions). Use the endpoint for your account region.
settings.moonshot.baseURL: API base URL (without /chat/completions). Use the endpoint for your account region.
settings.ollama.baseURL: Ollama OpenAI-compatible base URL. Local HTTP or HTTPS is supported. Beacon does not install or start Ollama.
settings.model: Chat model ID. Fetch and select models from the Beacon sidebar, or enter an exact model ID here.
